name: Granisetron Hydrochloride

fda.text: Serotonin Syndrome The development of serotonin syndrome has been reported with 5-HT3 receptor antagonists alone but particularly with concomitant use of serotonergic drugs (e.g., selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), monoamine oxidase inhibitors,…

summary: Granisetron Hydrochloride carries a warning for serotonin syndrome, a serious drug reaction that can happen when taken alone or especially when used alongside certain other medications like SSRIs, SNRIs, and monoamine oxidase inhibitors [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a low score for liver effects [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a low score for heart effects [M].
